script: Chapter 12. Pricing, Proposals, Contracts and Delivery. Work out your minimum hourly rate: your monthly income plus costs, divided by the hours you can bill. A proposal states the client's situation, goals, scope, exclusions, price, and next steps. Always use a written agreement. Recap: price for value, write everything down, and get a local professional to review the contract. This video is general information, not legal advice.
